text:
emma: quick note — samplekit fncall tests flapping on compact JSON mode when auth retry happens.

raj: repro steps?

emma: yep. run `./scripts/samplekit/test-fncall.sh` (python sdk). failure happens when the call gets an auth retry; SDK sends second request with same tool call but wrapper compresses -> response ends up double-encoded. log excerpt:

```
WARN retry: 401 -> refreshing token
SEND payload: {"input":"...","tools":[{"name":"get_user","args":"[\"...\"]"}]}
RECV: "[\"{\\\"id\\\":1,\\\"name\\\":\"joe\\\"}\"]"
ERROR schema-validate: expected object but got string
```

lisa: :face_with_raised_eyebrow: seen similar with Node SDK where compact mode strips line breaks differently. Could be `content-type` mismatch plus retry wrapper re-serializing.

tom: can we add a circuit-breaker / dedupe on identical fncalls within 200ms? avoids double-run and keeps schema stable.

raj: short-term: add a retry-hook that checks if body already looks JSON-encoded (starts with `"` or `[` quoted) then skip re-encode. Also add unit that runs `schema-lint` on tool outputs in CI.

emma: I can push a tiny helper change: `sdk/helpers/json_mode_fix.js` with `if (/^\s*\"|^\s*\[|^\s*\{/ .test(body)) return body;` will guard. Not ideal but unblock.

lisa: create a test covering Node+Python parity and add to samplekit CI. Also file a devex bug for longer fix: ensure retry serializes/merges identically across SDKs.

ci-bot: test run queued: #3321.

raj: agreed. Emma, can you open PR with the helper and add the test? then assign to me for review.

emma: done, PTAL https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/812 :thumbsup:
